description: Strengthen manifest validation and add comprehensive test coverage. Enhance validation to reject empty hashes, placeholder values (TODO, FIXME, empty strings), and inconsistent actions. Create comprehensive test suite with 20+ tests covering all artifact actions (ADD, UPDATE, EXTEND, REUSE, REJECT), path validation (traversal attacks, protected paths), hash validation, and fail-closed behavior from FEAT-001.
steps: 1. Read existing validate_manifest method in services/project-ai/app/intake/placement_manifest.py to understand current validation rules

2. Add new validation functions in services/project-ai/app/placement/artifact_policy.py: validate_content_hash(hash: str) -> Tuple[bool, str] to check for empty, placeholder, or malformed hashes (must be 64-char hex for SHA-256)

3. Add validate_placement_action(action: PlacementDecision, repository_match: Optional[RepositoryArtifact]) -> Tuple[bool, str] to ensure action consistency (e.g., UPDATE requires repository_match, ADD requires no match)
4. Integrate new validators into determine_action and get_target_path functions, raising ValueError on validation failures

5. Create comprehensive test file services/project-ai/tests/unit/test_artifact_policy_comprehensive.py (new file) with test classes: TestHashValidation (8 tests: valid hash, empty hash, TODO placeholder, FIXME placeholder, short hash, non-hex hash, None hash, whitespace hash), TestActionConsistency (6 tests: ADD with no match, ADD with match rejected, UPDATE with match, UPDATE without match rejected, REUSE with identical hash, EXTEND with variant), TestPathSafety (4 tests: traversal attack, protected .git, protected node_modules, valid relative path), TestFailClosed (3 tests: snapshot unavailable raises exception, snapshot load failure raises exception, empty evidence list raises exception)
6. Add integration test in services/project-ai/tests/integration/test_manifest_validation.py (new file) to verify rejected manifests are never persisted to disk or database
7. Update README.md or docs/architecture/artifact-policy.md with behavior change notes explaining fail-closed policy and strengthened validation
acceptance_criteria: validate_content_hash rejects empty strings, 'TODO', 'FIXME', '', hashes not matching 64-char hex pattern
validate_placement_action rejects inconsistent action/match combinations (UPDATE without match, ADD with match unless intentional)
Test suite has minimum 20 tests covering all scenarios listed
All new tests pass: pytest services/project-ai/tests/unit/test_artifact_policy_comprehensive.py -v shows 20+ passed
Integration test proves rejected manifests are not written to storage
Documentation updated with fail-closed behavior explanation
verification: Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/unit/test_artifact_policy_comprehensive.py -v --tb=short and confirm 20+ tests pass
Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/integration/test_manifest_validation.py -v to verify integration test passes
Run full existing test suite: pytest services/project-ai/tests/test_artifact_policy.py -v to ensure no regressions
Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/unit/ -v to verify all unit tests pass
Manually verify documentation exists: cat README.md or cat docs/architecture/artifact-policy.md | grep -i 'fail-closed\|behavior change'
